title: Scrum priorities · Practice
description: Explain backlog accountability, protecting the Sprint Goal and inspecting progress. Three original practice questions.

keyIdeas.text: The Product Owner is accountable for ordering the Product Backlog to support product value and the Product Goal, considering stakeholder input.
During a Sprint, Developers and the Product Owner can negotiate scope as they learn, but changes must not endanger the Sprint Goal or reduce quality.
Developers use the Daily Scrum to inspect progress toward the Sprint Goal and adapt their plan, rather than merely report status to a manager.

misconceptions: The loudest stakeholder owns the Product Backlog order.
All Sprint scope is either completely fixed or freely replaceable.
The Daily Scrum exists to give a manager individual status reports.
